{{Quote|Ten to one he'll fight too."<br />"Oh, he'll fight, all right. He's way too stupid to realize that anyone who can make a Connor net that big will have plenty of other tricks up his sleeve.|[[Maris Ferasi]] and Dubrak Qennto discussing Progga|<ref name="OBF" />}}
A '''skirmish''' occurred in a [[Unidentified Unknown Regions star system (skirmish between Progga and Picket Force Two)|star system]] in the [[Unknown Regions/Legends|Unknown Regions]] in [[27 BBY/Legends|27 BBY]]. [[Progga]] the [[Hutt/Legends|Hutt]] had been attacking the ''[[Bargain Hunter]]'' and following them even when they made [[Hyperspace/Legends|hyperspace]] jumps. He was doing this in an attempt to hijack them and steal their cargo of rare [[Hair/Legends|furs]] and [[firegem]]s which were supposed to be delivered to Progga's rivel [[Drixo]] the Hutt. Before Progga and [[Dubrak Qennto]] finished talking (Qennto trying to reason with Progga) the [[Chiss/Legends|Chiss]] fired a [[Conner net]] at both of the [[Starship/Legends|ships]]. While the ''Bargain Hunter'' was place out of commission, [[Progga's starship]] was built to resist the Conner nets. Progga, prepared to fight, turned his starship around to confront the beings who had launched the nets; [[Picket Force Two/Legends|Picket Force Two]] of the [[Chiss Expansionary Fleet/Legends|Chiss Expansionary Fleet]] composed of a [[Cruiser/Legends|cruiser]] and three [[Chiss fighter|fighter]] escorts commanded by [[Force Commander]] [[Mitth'raw'nuruodo/Legends|Mitth'raw'nuruodo]]. What issued was a six [[Standard minute/Legends|minute]] fight between Progga and the ''[[Springhawk/Legends|Springhawk]]''<ref name="OBF" />

==Behind the scenes==
The Skirmish between the Chiss and Progga was described in [[Outbound Flight (novel)|''Outbound Flight'']] released in 2006 and written by [[Timothy Zahn]]. However, the skirmish was not given a name in the novel.
